```sql
with captures as (
    select
        a.order_id,
        a.amount_minor,
        row_number() over (
            partition by a.order_id, a.amount_minor
            order by a.attempt_no, a.attempt_id
        ) as capture_rank
    from payment_attempts a
    join orders o on o.order_id = a.order_id
    join showrooms s on s.showroom_id = o.showroom_id
    join cities ci on ci.city_id = s.city_id
    where not a.is_test
      and not o.is_test
      and a.status = 'captured'
      and s.country_code in ('GB')
      and ci.name = 'London'
      and a.business_date between date '2026-09-01' and date '2026-09-09'
)
select
    null as key,
    cast(round(sum(amount_minor) * 1.0 / nullif(count(distinct order_id), 0)) as bigint) as value
from captures
where capture_rank = 1
order by value
```
